message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning (oregano, basil, thyme) | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley or basil, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (1 L) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Top layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Optional: extra mozzarella or a sprinkle of oregano | as desired |

### Optional Extras
- **Spinach**: sautéed and drained, 2–3 cups, folded into the ricotta mixture.
- **Mushrooms**: sliced and sautéed, 1 cup, added to the meat sauce.
- **Pesto**: swirl a few spoonfuls into the meat sauce for extra flavor.

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your taste and the size of your baking dish. Enjoy your lasagna!
